Restore Zig 0.16.0 as the supported toolchain for stability.

## Changed

- Restore the runtime, build configuration, examples, tests, and libvaxis pin
  from v0.1.2, before the Zig 0.17 migration.
- Require Zig 0.16.0 for this release. Zig 0.17 is not supported by this version.
- Publish the restored implementation as v0.1.4; existing releases remain unchanged.

This avoids the Zig 0.17.0 terminal-state memory corruption and aligned
Future-result failures reproduced during development. No new features are added.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/hiroaqii/chasen/compare/v0.1.3...v0.1.4
